1935, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 329 Cont.
Apr. 9 Thom. ODonnell - 38 - Battle Creek ....
Rev. Mckinnon - Cincinnatti - again
10 Rol Flynn - 5 - totally deaf since 2 yrs. Had spinal maningitis. Father promised to have Masses said if boy were spared. Child recovered perfectly. Then father took to drink & refused to keep promise saying boy would have been all right even had he never promised .... Enrolled again Today.
Paul Gagnon - 53 - drinks Mrs. Wolff .... 42 ... away from 3 & husband near 4 yrs .... Barbara Fl. - 6 - scarlet fever ... in Kiefer's
John O'Neill & Daughter - losing out in the Faith .... married out of Church ....
Eileen Trand11 - 22 - mastoid operation expected. Marcella M. Thompson - 14 - Epileptic. Edw'd Collins - bad knee - Dr. To- mor. Phil Bourosa - cataract cured - not yet 100% .... work ..... Blank Page
Page 330 Page 331 Apr. 9 John Cullen - 22 - Epileptic - like sleeping
Mrs. Anna Adams - 30 - heart & nerves ... since last May ... began to walk again in January at Monastery ... To-day quite improved.
10 Ellen Nagle - 64 - Enrolled 3 weeks before Thanksgiving for groth in stomach ... seeming cancer. Operation averted - took good hearty dinner on Thanksgiving ... groth gone ... Deo Gr.
11 Patrick V. Laffin - 45 - only child threatened with spinal maningitis was enrolled while being examined and treated. At time of enrollment April 6 improvement started. Father has not as yet been to Communion fulfilling promise - boy not so well To-day.
